what: kè đường Hạ Long, a piece of 2 m of the sloped sea wall of concrete of Hạ Long, from the walk down to the rocks at the water
uses: Plan 0026, R4, R6, Q12: under the walk of the sea of Hạ Long. There is no walk at the level of the sand along Hạ Long: the slope goes down to rocks and water (photos 1 to 3, 2020 and 2021). A piece of a row along a line, as the sidewalk pieces of World: two pieces in a row join with no gap.

photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: The sea wall of Hạ Long to the north: a smooth sloped face of concrete from the parapet down to rocks at the water, the parapet of rough stone, the walk with lamp posts of white globes, the road, hotels and Bãi Trước far away.

photos.author: Venanzio_KH (Flickr)
photos.shows: The sea wall of Hạ Long from its foot: the sloped face of concrete panels down to rocks and the water, the walk on top with its low parapet, lamp posts of four globes, the road, a white hotel of about 7 storeys with the letters HA LONG HOTEL.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: Hạ Long empty in the lockdown: the walk of the sea with a low parapet of light stone with dark red square pillars about every 10 m, lamp posts of four and five globes, benches, the road with a double yellow line.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: From a drone over the sea: the sloped sea wall of Hạ Long from the south end of Bãi Trước to the jetty of Cầu Đá with the domes of its terminal, flat rocks at the foot of the slope, the boats of the bay; no walk at the level of the sand.

checks: Views: from the sea, side (the profile), far (60 m).
A smooth face of concrete panels at about 35 degrees, with rust brown stains, and big rocks at its foot.

envelope.depth.how: Photos 0 and 1: the slope is about 1.5 times as long as it is high; not measured.

envelope.height.how: The game takes the height from the ground of plan 0005 (the walk 2 m to 9 m over the beach); 4 m is a mean.

parts.slope.sizes.panel.how: Photo 1: the joints of the panels are about as far apart as the parapet is long between two lamp posts divided by five: about 2 m.

parts.slope.at.how: The base point of the model (the top edge under the parapet).

parts.slope.color.how: Photos 0 and 1: light grey concrete with rust brown stains near the foot.

parts.toe.sizes.rock.how: Photo 1: the rocks are about as big as a panel is high divided by three: 0.5 m to 0.8 m.

parts.toe.at.how: At the foot of the slope (photos 0, 1, 3).
